caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a dress, shown without a figure inside. The dress is rendered primarily in a soft cream or light beige color, featuring long sleeves, a high neckline, and a fitted bodice with visible button details down the front. The skirt is elaborately draped and gathered, with a bustle at the back and a flounced hem at the bottom. The dress is decorated with clusters of flowers, primarily red roses with green leaves, interspersed with smaller pale yellow flowers. The floral decorations are positioned on the right shoulder, right forearm, and along the right side of the skirt, extending diagonally downward toward the hem. The background is plain and unadorned, putting full focus on the intricately designed garment.
title: Dress
